title: VAV3 is associated with atherosclerosis and ox-LDL-induced endothelial dysfunctional remodeling.
authors: Wang, Guorong; Pu, Chen; Li, Qing; Liu, Qiang; Wan, Xiaobin; Deng, Jun; Dai, Min; Xie, Bin; Huang, Lianghui; Zhao, YanPing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究VAV3在动脉粥样硬化及ox-LDL诱导内皮重塑中的作用，属纯湿实验与转录组分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atherosclerosis is a major cause of ischemic stroke and is characterized by complex immune-metabolic dysregulation. VAV3, a Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor, regulates multiple cellular processes, but its role in vascular pathology remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the function and mechanism of VAV3 in atherosclerosis. METHODS: Transcriptomic datasets (GSE43292 and GSE28829) were analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes and disease-associated co-expression modules using weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA). The Boruta and LASSO algorithms were applied to screen for disease-associated signatures. Functional validation was performed in ox-LDL-stimulated HUVECs using VAV3 gain- and loss-of-function approaches. Assessments included cell proliferation, apoptosis, intracellular calcium accumulation, migration, lipid deposition, inflammatory factor secretion, and NF-kappaB pathway activation. In vivo validation was conducted in high-fat diet-fed APOE(-/-) mice. RESULTS: Integrated transcriptomic analysis revealed concurrent immune activation and metabolic reprogramming in carotid plaques. WGCNA identified the MEgreen module as highly associated with atherosclerosis, and machine learning analyses selected CCR1 and VAV3 as public-dataset-derived candidate molecular signatures. In APOE(-/-) mice, atherosclerotic lesions showed increased lipid deposition, elevated inflammatory mediators, and enhanced VAV3 expression. In ox-LDL-treated HUVECs, VAV3 overexpression further enhanced cell viability, proliferation, and migration, reduced apoptosis, and increased intracellular calcium accumulation and lipid deposition, indicating a shift toward an abnormal proliferative and apoptosis-resistant endothelial phenotype. In contrast, VAV3 knockdown attenuated these ox-LDL-induced abnormal changes and partially restored the cellular phenotype toward the control state. VAV3 modulation also altered GRB2 expression and p65 phosphorylation, accompanied by changes in IL-6, TNF-alpha, CRP, and Lp-PLA2 secretion. Co-IP further suggested an association between GRB2 and p-P65. These findings indicate that VAV3 may be associated with maladaptive endothelial remodeling and NF-kappaB-related inflammatory activation under ox-LDL stimulation. CONCLUSION: VAV3 is upregulated in atherosclerotic lesions and may contribute to ox-LDL-induced maladaptive endothelial remodeling, characterized by abnormal proliferation, apoptosis resistance, calcium accumulation, lipid deposition, and inflammatory activation. However, its clinical diagnostic value, therapeutic feasibility, and causal role in vivo require further validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：动脉粥样硬化是缺血性卒中的主要原因，其特征是复杂的免疫-代谢失调。VAV3作为一种Rho鸟嘌呤核苷酸交换因子，调控多种细胞过程，但其在血管病理学中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨VAV3在动脉粥样硬化中的功能及机制。方法：分析转录组数据集（GSE43292和GSE28829），利用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）鉴定差异表达基因和疾病相关共表达模块。应用Boruta和LASSO算法筛选疾病相关特征。在ox-LDL刺激的人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）中，通过VAV3功能获得和功能丧失方法进行功能验证。评估内容包括细胞增殖、凋亡、细胞内钙积累、迁移、脂质沉积、炎症因子分泌及NF-kappaB通路激活。在高脂饮食喂养的APOE(-/-)小鼠中进行体内验证。结果：整合转录组分析揭示颈动脉斑块中免疫激活和代谢重编程同时发生。WGCNA鉴定出MEgreen模块与动脉粥样硬化高度相关，机器学习分析选择CCR1和VAV3作为公共数据集来源的候选分子特征。在APOE(-/-)小鼠中，动脉粥样硬化病变显示脂质沉积增加、炎症介质升高及VAV3表达增强。在ox-LDL处理的HUVECs中，VAV3过表达进一步增强细胞活力、增殖和迁移，减少凋亡，并增加细胞内钙积累和脂质沉积，表明细胞向异常增殖和抗凋亡的内皮表型转变。相反，VAV3敲低减弱了这些ox-LDL诱导的异常变化，并部分恢复细胞表型至对照状态。VAV3调控还改变了GRB2表达和p65磷酸化，伴随IL-6、TNF-alpha、CRP和Lp-PLA2分泌的变化。Co-IP进一步提示GRB2与p-P65之间存在关联。这些发现表明，VAV3可能与ox-LDL刺激下的适应不良性内皮重塑及NF-kappaB相关炎症激活有关。结论：VAV3在动脉粥样硬化病变中上调，可能参与ox-LDL诱导的适应不良性内皮重塑，其特征为异常增殖、抗凋亡、钙积累、脂质沉积和炎症激活。然而，其临床诊断价值、治疗可行性及体内因果作用仍需进一步验证。
